Sekkhattika (The Triplet on the State of Training)
Section on Analysis:
Root Condition.

Dependent on a state pertaining to training, a state pertaining to training arises by way of root condition: dependent on one aggregate pertaining to training, three aggregates [arise] … two aggregates … [and so forth].

Dependent on a state of one in training (sekha), a state that is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training arises by way of the root condition: dependent on the aggregates of one in training, mind-produced matter arises.

Dependent on a state of one in training, states that are both of one in training and neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training arise by way of the root condition: dependent on one aggregate of one in training, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise … [and so on] … dependent on two aggregates … [and so on] … *Note: The term "sekkha" refers to a person in training on the path; "nevasekkhanāsekkha" refers to states such as mind-produced matter which are neither specifically mundane nor supramundane.*

Dependent on a state that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner, there arises a state that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner by way of root condition:

dependent on one aggregate that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … two aggregates … at the moment of rebirth-linking … dependent on the aggregates, there arises the [heart-]base;
dependent on the [heart-]base, there arise the aggregates; [dependent on] one great primary element … [and so forth].
Dependent on three great primary elements (mahābhūta) … dependent on two great primary elements, two great primary elements [arise];
dependent on the great primary elements, mind-produced matter, kamma-born matter, and derived matter [arise].

Dependent on a state that is both for-trainees and neither-for-trainees-nor-non-trainees, a state that is neither-for-trainees-nor-non-trainees arises by way of root condition: dependent on the aggregates of one in training and the great primary elements, mind-produced matter [arises].

Dependent on a state that is both beyond training and neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training, there arises a state that is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training by way of root condition: dependent on the aggregates beyond training and the great elements, mind-produced matter arises.
Object Condition, etc.:
Dependent on a state of one in training, there arises a state of one in training by way of object condition … by way of predominance condition.

(There is no rebirth-linking) … by way of proximity condition … by way of contiguity condition … by way of conascence condition (all great primaries should be included) … by way of mutuality condition … by way of support condition … by way of decisive support condition … by way of prenascence condition … by way of repetition condition—
one dependent on one trainee aggregate, three aggregates arise … two aggregates … and so forth.
Dependent on a state that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner, a state that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner arises by way of repetition condition:
dependent on one aggregate that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner, three aggregates arise … [and so on] … two aggregates … [and so on] … By way of kamma condition; by way of result condition:
dependent on one resultant learner aggregate, three aggregates arise … [and so on] … two aggregates … [and so on] …. (Three; complete.)

Dependent on a state of one beyond training (*asekkha*), a state of one beyond training arises by way of resultant condition (*vipākapaccaya*): dependent on one aggregate of one beyond training... [three].

Dependent on a state that is neither of one beyond training nor of one in training (*nevasekkhanāsekkha*), a state that is neither of one beyond training nor of one in training arises by way of resultant condition:
dependent on one resultant aggregate that is neither of one beyond training nor of one in training, three aggregates and mind-produced matter arise... [etc.]
Two aggregates ... pe ... at the moment of rebirth-linking ... pe ... dependent on the aggregates, the [heart-]base arises; dependent on the [heart-]base, the aggregates arise;
one great primary element ... pe ....

Dependent on a state that is both trainee and neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee, a state that is neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee arises by way of resultant condition: dependent on resultant trainee aggregates and great primaries, mind-produced matter arises.

Dependent on a state that is both beyond training (asekkha) and neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training (nevasekkhanāsekkha), a state that is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training arises by way of resultant condition (vipākapaccaya): dependent on the aggregates beyond training and the great primary elements (mahābhūta), mind-produced matter (cittasamuṭṭhāna-rūpa) arises.

[Dependent on] a state of one in training (sekkha), a state of one in training arises by way of nutriment condition (āhārapaccaya)… by way of faculty condition (indriyapaccaya)… by way of jhāna condition (jhānapaccaya).
… path-condition … association-condition … dissociation-condition … presence-condition … absence-condition … disappearance-condition … non-disappearance-condition.
Section on Enumeration.
In the pure root condition there are nine; in the object condition, three; in the predominance condition, nine; in the proximity condition, three; in the contiguity condition, three;

in the conascence condition, nine; in the mutuality condition, three; in the support condition, nine; in the decisive support condition, three; in the prenascence condition, three; in the repetition condition, two.
In the case of kamma, there are nine; in the case of resultant, nutriment, faculty, jhāna, and path, there are nine; in the case of association, three; in the case of dissociation, nine;
in the case of presence, nine; in the case of absence, three; in the case of disappearance, three; in the case of non-disappearance, nine. (Thus it should be counted. This is the Positive (Anuloma).
1.12.1.2. Analysis of the Negative Section on Conditions (Paccayapaccanīya Vibhaṅgavāra): Not-root Condition (Nahetu)
Dependent on a state that is neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee, there arises a state that is neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee by way of the not-root condition:

dependent on one rootless aggregate that is neither-trainee-nor-non-trainee, there arise three aggregates and mind-produced matter … two aggregates … at the moment of rootless rebirth-linking … dependent on the aggregates, the [heart-]base; dependent on the [heart-]base, the aggregates.

The aggregates; one great primary element … external … nutriment-originated … temperature-originated … one great primary element of non-percipient beings … dependent on doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied aggregates,
arises doubt-accompanied and restlessness-accompanied delusion.

Dependent on a state that is beyond-learning, a state that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner arises by way of the object condition: dependent on beyond-learning aggregates, mind-produced matter arises.

Dependent on a state that is both beyond training (*asekkha*) and neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training, a state that is neither-in-training-nor-beyond-training arises by way of not-object condition: dependent on the aggregates beyond training and the great primary elements, mind-originated matter arises.
